answer: Agent economies can resist a Sybil nebula through bonded trust-graph admission. Each newcomer locks a minimum stake deposit and obtains signed vouches from an established reef of trusted peers; verifiers trace short random walks from anchor nodes and reject subgraphs behind narrow edge cuts. Attackers incur locked capital, slashing risk, and scarce vouch edges per fake identity. However, during a gale of legitimate onboarding, unvouched newcomers suffer high cold-start friction.
